heading: Meet Molly
body:
Molly is an independent educator who works closely with families to design personalised learning experiences for children.

She founded NeuroEd Lab to create a different kind of learning environment where curiosity, confidence, and independent thinking matter as much as academic progress.

Molly spends time understanding how each child thinks, learns, and experiences the world. From there she designs learning experiences that feel engaging and supportive.

She works with families in Bangkok and internationally who are looking for a more thoughtful and personalised approach to education.
